title: Resize Finished Clip Without Remaking
tests: Tests whether a post-delivery platform change reuses and reformats the existing video rather than generating a replacement.

faults.what: The supplied output remains widescreen rather than the requested vertical 9:16 format.
The requested plain navy padding above and below the centred widescreen picture is absent.

judge.summary: The cartoon and title are clearly visible, but the requested vertical resize with navy padding has not been delivered.

must_haves.item: The revised deliverable has a vertical 9:16 frame.
The complete original widescreen picture is centred with plain navy padding above and below, without cropping or distortion.
must_haves.why: The cartoon fills the landscape frame, with no navy padding above or below.

must_haves.item: The robot, plant, background and animation match the previously delivered clip rather than a newly generated interpretation.
must_haves.why: No separate original clip or reference frames are supplied for comparison.

must_haves.item: The words 'Small steps' remain fully visible throughout.
must_haves.why: The exact title is fully visible at the top in every supplied sample.

must_haves.item: The revised video preserves the original 8-second duration, action order and timing.
must_haves.why: The output is identified as eight seconds, but the original clip is unavailable to compare action order and timing.
Audio cannot be assessed from still frames.
